stories.title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
stories.summary: A biotech startup let an agent choose a gene therapy and successfully inject the treatment, offering a startling glimpse of the future of research labs.
stories.zh_title: 人工智慧代理人將藥物注射到活老鼠的大腦中
stories.zh_summary: 一家生技新創公司讓代理人選擇一種基因療法並成功注射該療法，讓人們對研究實驗室的未來有了驚人的了解。

stories.title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’
stories.summary: Apple's new CEO defended the company's current position in the AI landscape.
stories.zh_title: 蘋果執行長表示公司不想“為了人工智慧而推出人工智慧”
stories.zh_summary: 蘋果新任執行長捍衛了公司目前在人工智慧領域的地位。

stories.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
stories.summary: An NAACP lawsuit accuses the SpaceX-owned AI company of violating the Clean Air Act.
stories.zh_title: 法官允許全國有色人種協進會繼續推進有關 xAI 資料中心污染的訴訟
stories.zh_summary: NAACP 提起訴訟，指控 SpaceX 旗下的人工智慧公司違反《清潔空氣法》。

stories.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could

stories.zh_title: 在 Meta 之前我就已經製作了一個 AI Tamagotchi
stories.zh_summary: 馬克祖克柏的 Meta 透過賦予 AI 一張柔軟的小臉，讓 AI 看起來非常可愛——而在這個假期，他想向你推銷一個 Muse Charm，這樣你就可以像電子蛋一樣帶著你的快樂 AI 助手到處走。但我不會買，因為我們家有繆斯魅力。它 […]

stories.title: Stocks started the week with promise but ended in despair. Our take on the big reversal
stories.summary: Big Tech earnings reignited AI spending fears, sending investors into defensive stocks.
stories.zh_title: 本週股市開局充滿希望，但最終卻陷入絕望。我們對大逆轉的看法
stories.zh_summary: 大型科技公司的獲利重新引發了對人工智慧支出的擔憂，促使投資者買入防禦性股票。

stories.title: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
stories.summary: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat.
stories.zh_title: Meta 的繆斯可以顛覆所有類型的企業。還沒有
stories.zh_summary: 過去幾週，各公司一直試圖讓投資人放心，Muse 和其他人工智慧代理商帶來的更多是機會，而不是威脅。

stories.title: Medicare used AI to pre-approve patient care, and it immediately led to a large drop in medical services
stories.summary: Medicare is testing the use of AI to conduct prior authorizations to target wasteful medical spending
stories.zh_title: 醫療保險使用人工智慧預先批准患者護理，立即導致醫療服務大幅下降
stories.zh_summary: 醫療保險正在測試使用人工智慧進行事先授權，以消除浪費的醫療支出

stories.title: Want guaranteed income in retirement without an annuity? Try laddering I bonds.
stories.summary: The new I-bond interest rate could be 5.5% or 5.4%, but that shouldn’t change your strategy.
stories.zh_title: 想要在沒有年金的情況下獲得有保障的退休收入嗎？試試攀爬 I Bond。
stories.zh_summary: 新的 I 債券利率可能為 5.5% 或 5.4%，但這不應該改變您的策略。

stories.title: Humans are still doing the work behind some AI agents
stories.summary: AI agents from startups including Dazzle, Duckbill and Wajo still rely on human workers for calls and other real-world tasks when software falls short.
stories.zh_title: 人類仍在做一些人工智慧代理背後的工作
stories.zh_summary: 當軟體功能不足時，Dazzle、Duckbill 和 Wajo 等新創公司的人工智慧代理商仍然依賴人類工作者來完成通話和其他現實世界任務。
